declarations.description: Auto-growing message composer with slotted actions and an accessible send button.
declarations.name: ChatInput

cssParts.name: container
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the container element.

cssParts.name: textarea
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the textarea element.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the actions element.

cssParts.name: toolbar
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the toolbar element.

cssParts.name: send-button
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the send button element.

slots.description: Actions displayed before the send button, such as attachment or voice controls.
slots.name: toolbar

slots.description: Icon displayed inside the send button.
slots.name: send-icon

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Hint shown while the composer is empty.

members.name: value
members.description: Current message text. Set this property to update the composer programmatically.

members.name: name
members.description: Name used when the composer participates in a form.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables editing, sending, and form submission.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires a nonempty message for form validation.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: Maximum message length; -1 means unlimited.

members.name: minLength
members.description: Minimum message length; -1 means no minimum.

members.name: minRows
members.description: Minimum number of visible text rows before the composer grows.

members.name: enterBehavior
members.description: Controls whether unmodified Enter submits or inserts a newline.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the inner textarea.

members.name: sendLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the send button.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the native textarea.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects all message text.

members.name: setSelectionRange
members.description: Selects a range using native UTF-16 character offsets.

members.name: isDirty
members.description: Whether the user has edited the value since the last reset.

members.name: reset
members.description: Restores the initial `value` attribute and clears the dirty state.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Checks the native textarea constraints. Await `updateComplete` after changing properties.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Shows the browser's native validation feedback.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears the native validation message.

events.name: submit-message
events.description: Fired with the current message. Cancel the event to keep the value in the composer.
Fired on each edit, after `value` is updated.
events.name: input

events.description: Fired when an edit is committed.
events.name: change
